mapper.select:
select * from ( select
(NVL(day_plan_qty1, 0) + NVL(night_plan_qty1, 0)) as daily_total_qty, TRUNC(fq.DAY_FINISH_QTY) as day_finish_qty1, case when a.day_plan_qty1=0 then null when a.day_plan_qty1!=0 then (TRUNC(fq.DAY_FINISH_QTY)/a.day_plan_qty1) end as day_finish_rate1, TRUNC(fq.NIGHT_FINISH_QTY) as NIGHT_FINISH_QTY1, case when a.night_plan_qty1=0 then null when a.night_plan_qty1!=0 then (TRUNC(fq.NIGHT_FINISH_QTY)/a.night_plan_qty1) end as night_finish_rate1, b.MONTH_PLAN_QTY as month_plan, CEIL(b.MONTH_REMAIN_QTY) as month_plan_os, log.change_machine, log.change_day_plan, log.change_night_plan,
(TRUNC(nvl(fq.NIGHT_FINISH_QTY, 0)) + TRUNC(nvl(fq.DAY_FINISH_QTY, 0))) AS total_finish_qty, CASE WHEN (TRUNC(NVL(a.day_plan_qty1, 0)) + TRUNC(NVL(a.night_plan_qty1, 0))) != 0 THEN trunc((nvl(fq.NIGHT_FINISH_QTY, 0) + nvl(fq.DAY_FINISH_QTY, 0)) / (TRUNC(NVL(a.day_plan_qty1, 0)) + TRUNC(NVL(a.night_plan_qty1, 0))), 4) ELSE 0 END AS daily_finish_rate
from t_cd15_schedule_result a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MATERIAL_CODE,MONTH_PLAN_QTY,MONTH_REMAIN_QTY FROM T_CD15_MONTH_PLAN_SURPLUS WHERE del_flag='0' and YEAR=#{year,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and MONTH=#{month,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) b on a.steel_strip_code1=b.MATERIAL_CODE LEFT JOIN T_CD15_DAY_FINISH_QTY fq on a.order_no = fq.order_no and fq.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN (/*调度员操作日志，判断调度员是否有做“转机台”或“调量”操作*/ SELECT schedule_id, max(decode(BEFORE_MACHINE_ID, AFTER_MACHINE_ID,0,1)) change_machine, max(decode(BEFORE_DAY_PLAN, AFTER_DAY_PLAN,0,1)) change_day_plan, max(decode(BEFORE_NIGHT_PLAN, AFTER_NIGHT_PLAN,0,1)) change_night_plan FROM T_CD15_DISPATCHER_LOG where schedule_date = #{scheduleDate} group by schedule_id ) log ON a.id = log.schedule_id where a.del_flag='0' and a.schedule_date = #{scheduleDate,jdbcType=DATE}
and INSTR(a.big_roll_code, #{bigRollCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and instr(','||a.machine_id||',', ','||#{machineId}||',')>0
and INSTR(a.steel_strip_code1, #{steelStripCode1,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and INSTR(a.steel_strip_code2, #{steelStripCode2,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and a.IS_RELEASE = #{isRelease ,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.id in #{scheduleId} order by (case when instr(machine_id,',') > 0 then machine_id when machine_id is null or machine_id = '' then '0' else '-1' end) desc/*多个机台 和 没有机台的排在前面*/, a.big_roll_code,a.CUTTING_ANGLE asc ) t
order by ${orderStr}

select
fq.DAY_FINISH_QTY as day_finish_qty1, case when a.day_plan_qty1=0 then null when a.day_plan_qty1!=0 then (fq.DAY_FINISH_QTY/a.day_plan_qty1) end as day_finish_rate1,
fq.NIGHT_FINISH_QTY as NIGHT_FINISH_QTY1, case when a.night_plan_qty1=0 then null when a.night_plan_qty1!=0 then (fq.NIGHT_FINISH_QTY/a.night_plan_qty1) end as night_finish_rate1,
b.MONTH_PLAN_QTY as monthPlan,b.MONTH_REMAIN_QTY as monthPlanOs
from t_cd15_schedule_result a
LEFT JOIN ( select MATERIAL_CODE,MONTH_PLAN_QTY,MONTH_REMAIN_QTY,YEAR,MONTH from T_CD15_MONTH_PLAN_SURPLUS where del_flag='0' ) b on a.steel_strip_code1=b.MATERIAL_CODE and b.YEAR=TO_CHAR(a.schedule_date,'yyyy') and b.MONTH=TO_CHAR(a.schedule_date,'MM')
LEFT JOIN T_CD15_DAY_FINISH_QTY fq on a.schedule_date =fq.schedule_date and a.steel_strip_code1=fq.STEEL_STRIP_CODE
where a.id=#{id} and ROWNUM=1
